newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Woodside, Shell study Darwin LNG venture.
newsitem.headline: Woodside, Shell study Darwin LNG venture.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday that it along with a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group plan a feasibility study of a large liquefied natural gas (LNG) export venture in Darwin, Northern Territory.
Woodside said Darwin offered proximity to potentially large gas resources in offshore Australia and to Asian markets which hold considerable potential for growth in LNG demand.

It said the parties already have significant gas discoveries in the Sunrise, Troubadour, Loxton Shoals and Evans Shoal gas fields which, while not yet fully appraised, were expected to contain at least five trillion cubic feet of recoverable gas.
The companies said they also intended to hold discussions with third parties with offshore gas reserves within the region.
